fix.b: Set compilerOptions.rootDir to the src root that contains every included .ts file, or stop importing files outside it.

err: missing go.sum entry for module providing package

fix.b: go mod tidy

err: go: inconsistent vendoring

fix.b: go mod vendor

err: package: build constraints exclude all Go files

fix.b: The files are behind //go:build tags or GOOS/GOARCH that do not match this build. Pass -tags or build on the intended OS.

err: Error: Could not find expected browser (chrome) locally. Run npx puppeteer browsers install chrome

fix.b: npx puppeteer browsers install chrome

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Server not initialized

fix.b: Wait for initialize + initialized before tools/list or tools/call. Do not send tools/list as the first message.

err: ERROR: failed to solve: failed to compute cache key: failed to calculate checksum

fix.b: COPY/ADD source is missing or excluded by .dockerignore. Fix the path or the ignore file.

err: exec <PATH>: exec format error

fix.b: Image architecture does not match the host (amd64 vs arm64). Build with --platform linux/amd64 (or the host arch).

err: go: module declares its path as github.com/acme/widget but was required as github.com/acme/widgets

fix.b: The require/import path must equal the module line in that module's go.mod. Fix the import path or the module declaration, then go mod tidy.

err: go: go.mod file not found in current directory or any parent directory; see <STR>

fix.b: Run from the directory that contains go.mod, or create one with go mod init <module-path>. GOPATH mode is not the default on Go 1.16+.

err: Error [ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED]: Package subpath <STR> is not defined by <STR>

fix.b: Import only subpaths listed in the package.json exports map. Deep imports of unexported files fail on Node 16+.

err: error TS1479: The current file is a CommonJS module whose imports will produce <STR> calls

fix.b: Set package.json type=module, or tsconfig module/moduleResolution to NodeNext. A CJS file cannot require() an ESM-only package.

err: error TS5110: Option <STR> must be set to <STR> when option <STR> is set to <STR>.

fix.b: In tsconfig.json set compilerOptions.module to NodeNext to match moduleResolution NodeNext (or set both to Bundler for Vite/Next).

err: Error: You are attempting to export <STR> from a component marked with <STR>. This is not allowed.

fix.b: Move export const metadata (and generateMetadata) into a Server Component page or layout. Client files cannot export metadata.

err: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded.

fix.b: The URL never became ready. Start the app first, wait for a load state, or raise navigationTimeout. A goto timeout is not a selector bug.

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Connection closed

fix.b: The MCP child process exited. Check the server command and PATH, keep logs off stdout (stdio is the protocol), and finish initialize before tools/call.

err: COPY failed: file not found in build context or excluded by .dockerignore: package-lock.json

fix.b: COPY sources must exist in the build context and not be listed in .dockerignore. Run npm i to create package-lock.json, or drop that COPY.

err: RuntimeError: Expected all tensors to be on the same device, but found at least two devices, cuda:<N> and cpu!

fix.b: Move inputs with tensor.to(device) using the same device as the model (model.device or next(model.parameters()).device). Do not mix .cuda() tensors with CPU batches.

err: Error [ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION]: Unknown file extension <STR> for app.ts

fix.b: Node cannot execute TypeScript. Run with tsx or ts-node, compile first, or use node --experimental-strip-types on Node 22.6+.

err: Error: Cannot find module @modelcontextprotocol/sdk

fix.b: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk  # add it as a real dependency; npx does not install the SDK for a local MCP server

err: ImportError: libGL.so.<N>: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

fix.b: Use opencv-python-headless (or install libgl1). opencv-python links libGL, which headless CI images lack.

err: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at npipe:////<PATH> Is the docker daemon running?

fix.b: Start Docker Desktop. Windows talks over npipe:////./pipe/docker_engine; this is not the unix socket error.

err: go: updates to go.mod needed; to update it: go mod tidy

fix.b: go mod tidy

err: go: import cycle not allowed

fix.b: Break the cycle: move shared types to a third package. Go forbids A importing B while B imports A.

err: github.com/foo/bar@v1.<N>.<N>: invalid version: unknown revision v1.<N>.<N>

fix.b: The tag or commit is not on the remote. Use a tag that exists, a full commit SHA, or drop the pin and run go get module@latest.

err: Error: strict mode violation: locator(<STR>) resolved to <N> elements

fix.b: Narrow the locator until it matches one node (getByRole, nth, filter). Playwright strict mode refuses ambiguous locators.

err: Error: Protocol error (Target.setDiscoverTargets): Target closed.

fix.b: The browser or page was closed before the command ran. Await the page, do not kill Chromium in beforeEach, and do not reuse a page after context.close().

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Method not found: resources/list

fix.b: The server does not implement resources. Skip resources/list unless capabilities.resources is set in initialize, or use tools/list instead.

err: error TS2307: Cannot find module foo or its corresponding type declarations.

fix.b: Install the package and its types (@types/foo or the package's own types). Check tsconfig moduleResolution and that node_modules is not excluded.

err: error TS1259: Module can only be default-imported using the <STR> flag

fix.b: Set compilerOptions.esModuleInterop true (and allowSyntheticDefaultImports), or import * as pkg from 'cjs-lib'.

err: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package <STR> imported from

fix.b: ESM resolution needs the package in node_modules (or a file URL). Install it, or add the .js extension on relative imports under type=module.

err: Error: Failed to find Server Action. This request might be from an older or newer deployment.

fix.b: The client posted an action id the current build does not export. Redeploy so client and server share one build; do not mix stale .next with a new server.

err: Error: The default export is not a React Component in <STR>

fix.b: app/page.tsx must default-export a React component. Do not default-export a metadata object, a handler, or an async data function.

err: RuntimeError: No CUDA GPUs are available

fix.b: This machine has no visible CUDA device. Use device=cpu, install a matching NVIDIA driver, or run on a GPU host. torch.cuda.is_available() is false.

err: TypeError: Descriptors cannot be created directly.

fix.b: protobuf>=4.21 forbids constructing descriptors from generated code built for older protobuf. Pin protobuf<4 or regenerate *_pb2.py.

err: Error: Unable to locate executable file: docker. Please verify either the file path exists or the file can be found within a directory specified by the PATH environment variable.

fix.b: The GitHub Actions runner has no docker binary (or PATH dropped it). Use a docker-capable runner, or setup-buildx-action / setup-qemu-action first.

err: standard_init_linux.go: exec user process caused: no such file or directory

fix.b: The image ENTRYPOINT/CMD interpreter is missing, or the script has Windows CRLF so the kernel looks for /bin/sh\r. Convert shebangs to LF and match the base image arch.

err: denied: requested access to the resource is denied

fix.b: docker login to that registry and push to a repo you own. The tag must be registry/user/image:tag, not a Docker Hub library name.

err: go: go.mod requires go >= <N>.<N> (running go <N>.<N>.<N>; GOTOOLCHAIN=local)

fix.b: Install Go 1.23+ or unset GOTOOLCHAIN=local so the toolchain line can auto-download. Lowering the go line in go.mod is a last resort.

err: cgo: C compiler <STR> not found: exec: <STR>: executable file not found in %PATH%

fix.b: Install a C compiler (gcc, clang, or MSVC Build Tools) or set CGO_ENABLED=0 if the package does not need cgo. Race detector and SQLite bindings need a compiler.

err: go: github.com/foo/bar@v2.<N>.<N>: invalid version: module contains a go.mod file, so module path should have v2 suffix

fix.b: For major version 2+, the module path and import must include /v2 (github.com/foo/bar/v2). Do not require <STR> without the path suffix.

err: error TS2835: Relative import paths need explicit file extensions in ECMAScript imports when <STR> is <STR> or <STR>. Did you mean <STR>?

fix.b: Import './foo.js' (the emitted path), not './foo' or './foo.ts'. NodeNext resolution requires the .js extension on relative ESM imports.

err: error TS1343: The <STR> meta-property is only allowed when the <STR> option is <STR>, <STR>, <STR>, <STR>, <STR>, or <STR>.

fix.b: Set compilerOptions.module to NodeNext (or ESNext). CommonJS module cannot use import.meta; do not lower module just to silence this.

err: error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for <STR>.

fix.b: npm i -D @types/node. If compilerOptions.types lists "node", the package must be installed; otherwise drop "node" from types.

err: npm ci can only install packages with an existing package-lock.json or npm-shrinkwrap.json

fix.b: npm ci requires a committed lockfile. Check in package-lock.json, or run npm install once to create it. Do not npm ci in a repo that only has package.json.

err: Error: Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components unless you explicitly expose it by marking it with <STR>.

fix.b: Add 'use server' to the file that exports the function (a Server Action), or pass serializable data instead of a function into the Client Component.

err: Error: Image Optimization using the default loader is not compatible with `{ output: <STR> }`.

fix.b: output: 'export' has no Image Optimization server. Set images.unoptimized: true, or use a custom loader, or stop using output export.

err: TimeoutError: page.waitForSelector: Timeout 30000ms exceeded.

fix.b: The selector never appeared. Wait for a role/text locator, start the app first, or raise timeout. A wait timeout is not itself a bad selector.

err: Error: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation.

fix.b: The page navigated or reloaded mid-command. Await the navigation, then query the new document. Do not reuse ElementHandles from the old page.

err: Error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at <URL>

fix.b: Nothing is listening on that URL. Start the app (Playwright webServer in playwright.config) before page.goto. A refused connection is not a selector bug.

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Parse error

fix.b: The host sent non-JSON or concatenated frames on stdio. One JSON-RPC object per line; logs go to stderr only, never stdout.

err: Error: MCP error -<N>: Request timed out

fix.b: The tool call exceeded the host timeout. Return faster, stream progress, or raise the client timeout. Do not retry the same hung tool in a tight loop.

err: fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at <STR>

fix.b: Git 2.35+ refuses a checkout not owned by the current user. In CI: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" (or the container work path).

err: Error: Unable to locate executable file: pnpm. Please verify either the file path exists or the file can be found within a directory specified by the PATH environment variable.

fix.b: The runner has no pnpm on PATH. Enable corepack (corepack enable) or add pnpm/action-setup before the install step.

err: permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket at unix://<PATH>

fix.b: The user is not in the docker group, or dockerd is not running. Start the daemon and add the user to group docker. This is the Unix socket error, not the Windows npipe one.

err: RuntimeError: CUDA error: device-side assert triggered

fix.b: An index or dtype is invalid on GPU. Rerun with CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to get the real stack, then fix the tensor (often class index >= n_classes). Do not retry the same batch.

err: ValueError: numpy.ndarray size changed, may indicate binary incompatibility. Expected <N> from C header, got <N> from PyObject

fix.b: A C-extension was built against a different numpy ABI. Reinstall the extension against the installed numpy, or pin numpy to the version the wheel expects.

err: go test: -race requires cgo; enable cgo by setting CGO_ENABLED=<N>

fix.b: The race detector needs cgo. Unset CGO_ENABLED=0 and install a C compiler, or drop -race on this platform (common on Windows without gcc).

err: ERROR: failed to solve: failed to resolve source metadata for docker.io/library/node:<N>-alpine

fix.b: Docker Hub pull failed (auth, rate limit, or network). docker login, use a mirror/cache, or pin a digest already on the host. Retrying the same anonymous pull will keep failing.

err: Error [ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME]: Only file and data URLs are supported by the default ESM loader. Received protocol <STR>

fix.b: Node's default ESM loader does not import http(s) URLs. Install the package (or vendor the file) and import a file: URL or bare specifier. Do not import() a CDN URL.
